entities.summary: Hendrik van den Bergh, c. 1573 to 22 May 1638, was a professional soldier and lord of Stevensweert, in Limburg. From 1618 to 1637 he was also stadtholder of Upper Guelders, the only part of Guelders to remain loyal to Habsburg Spain during the Eighty Years War.
